title: Long-term live cell imaging during differentiation of human iPSC-derived neurons
protocol: Add 15 mM sterile HCl to reconstitute the lyophilized leptin.
Add 7.5 mM sterile NaOH to adjust pH and achieve a concentration of 1.25 mg/ml.
Aliquot 50 μl portions of the stock solution and store at -80°C.
Prepare fresh working solutions for injection 30 minutes before each time point.
Thaw iPSCs from a frozen stock.
Warm vitronectin aliquot at 20–25°C.
Dilute vitronectin in Cell Adhere dilution buffer (40 μL vitronectin per mL of buffer).
Coat culture vessels with the diluted vitronectin and incubate for 1 hour at 20–25°C.
Prepare complete StemFlex media with Y27632 (5 μL of 10 mM stock in 10 mL, final concentration 5 μM).
Incubate frozen iPSC stock in a 37°C water bath until ice disappears.
Transfer the thawed iPSCs into an empty 10-mL Falcon tube.
Add 4 mL of StemFlex media drop-wise to the iPSCs while shaking the tube.
Aspirate the vitronectin from each well of a 6-well plate.
Replace the aspirated wells with fresh StemFlex media, adding 2 mL per well.
Add 100 μL of iPSC suspension to one coated well as a starting point.
Check the cell density and add more iPSC suspension if needed to achieve optimal cell density.
Maintain the iPSC culture plate in the incubator, 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Do not let the vitronectin solution dry on the wells before adding the cell suspension.
Change StemFlex culture medium the next day without ROCK inhibitor and continue changing it every 2-3 days.
Monitor medium for color changes during NPC induction.
Coat a 6-well plate with Matrigel for 1 hour at 37°C, using 1 mL Matrigel per well.
Incubate the plate and pipette tips in the freezer for 10-15 minutes before starting the coating.
Keep the Matrigel on ice.
Aspirate the media carefully from wells with good iPSC colonies.
Wash the iPSCs gently with warm DMEM-F12.
Add 1 mL ReLeSR per well and aspirate after 5 seconds.
Rotate the plate containing iPSC colonies to ensure ReLeSR contacts all colonies.
Start a timer for 7 min at 20–25°C.
Collect detached iPSC colonies gently into 10 mL tubes using basal media [RDM].
Add 1 mL of basal media [RDM] to each well after detachment.
Aspirate Matrigel and add [RDMi] media, 2 ml per well.
Add 20 μL of iPSCs suspension into each well of the coated plates with a dilution factor of 1:50.
Add 50 μL of iPSCs suspension into each well of the coated plates with a dilution factor of 1:20.
Add 100 μL of iPSCs suspension into each well of the coated plates with a dilution factor of 1:10.
Check the cell density under the microscope.
Incubate cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 7 days.
Change media with fresh RDMi and small molecules every day for 7 days.
Coat a 6-well plate with Matrigel for 1 h at 37°C, using 1 mL Matrigel per well.
Thaw accutase at 20–25°C in 5 ml aliquots.
Aspirate the media carefully from the cells.
Wash NPCs gently with DMEM-F12 and aspirate gently.
Add 0.5 ml of accutase to each well containing the cells.
Make up basal [RDM] and [RDMm] media according to the materials tables.
Prepare 2 mL [RDMm] media for each well in a 6-well plate.
Incubate the samples for 5 min at 37°C.
Add 1.5 mL DMEM-F12 to each well.
Tap the plate gently to detach NPCs.
Pipette up and down three times to collect detached cells into 10-mL Falcon tubes.
If cell clusters remain undetached, use a cell strainer (40 μm diameter) to break up clusters.
For first passage of NPCs, dilute the cell suspension by a 1:3 ratio.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 200 g for 3 min at 20-25°C.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend cells in [RDMm] media with small molecules, using 6 mL of media per 2 mL of cell suspension.
Aspirate the Matrigel and add resuspended cell suspension to the coated well, 2 mL per well.
Incubate the NPCs at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Change media every 2 days.
Repeat step 6 to expand the NPCs further when the monolayer reaches 80%-90% confluency.
Centrifuge NPCs suspension at 200 g for 3 min at RT.
Count NPCs and freeze 1 × 10^6 NPCs in one vial.
Resuspend NPCs in CryoStor CS10 (freezing media).
Transfer 500 μL of NPCs in freezing media per vial.
Place the vial in a special freezing container to allow temperature to slowly cool down.
Keep at least 4 h at -80°C.
Transfer NPCs frozen vial into liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Pause point: When thawing NPCs, repeat steps 6a and 6b to coat the plate and prepare media.
Thaw NPCs quickly in a water bath at 37°C.
Add 5 mL of RDM basal media drop-wise while shaking.
Centrifuge cells at 200 g for 3 minutes at 20–25°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in RDMm.
Seed NPCs into Matrigel-coated 6-well plates.
Incubate plates at 37°C, 5% CO2 until NPCs reach 80-90% confluency.
Include ROCK inhibitor Y27632 in RDMm media for up to 24 hours during thawing.
For optimal neuronal differentiation, use NPCs passaged between P3 and P10.
Coat wells, coverslips, or chamber slides with poly-L-ornithine at 20 μg/mL.
Dilute poly-L-ornithine at a ratio of 1:5 in ultra-pure water to achieve 0.01% concentration.
Incubate the coating for at least 2 hours at 37°C.
Wash the coated wells or coverslips with ultrapure sterile water (or PBS) three times.
Ensure that the wells or coverslips are dry before proceeding.
Coat the wells, coverslips, or chamber slides with laminin at 20 μg/mL.
Incubate the coating for at least 2 hours at 37°C.
Calculate the amount of laminin needed for seeding based on available aliquots.
Dilute one laminin aliquot in 5-10 mL cold PBS and store at -20°C.
Thaw frozen laminin aliquot on ice for 10/15 minutes, spinning briefly if necessary.
Pre-cool pipette tips in the fridge when handling laminin.
Make up basal N2B21 media and N2B21+ media with growth factors according to materials tables.
Prepare 250 μL N2B21+ media per well for a 24-well plate.
Aspirate media on NPC monolayers carefully.
Wash NPC monolayers gently with DMEM-F12.
Add 0.5 mL accutase to each well and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 1.5 mL DMEM-F12 to each well after accutase treatment.
Gently detach NPCs by tapping the plate.
Collect detached cells gently into 10-mL Falcon tubes to obtain NPC suspension.
Count collected cells.
Seed NPCs into one well of a 24-well plate at a density corresponding to 3 × 10^4 cells per well, which is equivalent to 1.58 × 10^4 cells/cm².
Centrifuge NPC suspension at 200 g for 3 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend NPCs in N2B21+ media with small molecules and ROCK inhibitor Y27632 (5 μL in 10 mL final).
Add resuspended cells to laminin-coated culture wells, using 250 μl per well for 24-well plates.
Incubate the NPCs at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Perform a full media change with [N2B21+] containing fresh growth factors (without Y27632) at Day 1.
Replace half the media volume with an equivalent volume of fresh [N2B21+] containing fresh growth factors every 2–3 days starting from day 1 onwards.
Examine the cells daily for morphological changes.
Validate the identities and development of neurons by immunofluorescence using different NPC and/or neuronal markers at various developmental stages.
Enhance proliferation of NPCs by replacing NBM basal medium with 50% DMEMF-12 and 50% NBM basal medium from day 1 to day 3 if NPC number is low at the beginning of neuronal differentiation.
Do not let wells dry when changing for fresh [N2B21+] medium during media changes.
Leave a portion of conditioned media in the well sufficient to cover the cells.
Add 2 μM of 5-FdU to the culture around Day 10 until fixation at Day 14 if proliferative non-neuronal cells arise in the culture.
Detach and replate neurons to physically separate neuronal layer from non-neuronal cells.
Monitor neuronal differentiation from NPCs using long-term live cell imaging.
Use the IncuCyte instrument for imaging cultured cells within an incubator.
Adapt the protocol for other cell imaging microscopes as needed.
Record neuronal dynamics during neurogenesis steps.
Observe dynamics of intracellular organelles, such as the Golgi apparatus.
Follow organelles in live cells using specific dyes or fluorescent markers.
Seed NPCs with [N2B21+] in culture dishes compatible with the IncuCyte system.
Begin NPC differentiation to neurons as described in steps 10a to 10q.
Use an 8 wells iBidi μ-Slide for imaging if high resolution and neuronal attachment are required.
Add BODIPY TR Ceramide Golgi dye to the culture media at a 1:1000 dilution on day 1 of neuronal differentiation.
Repeat adding Golgi dye to the culture media every 2-3 days during differentiation.
Place the iBidi μ-Slide inside the IncuCyte imaging system and secure it on the slide holder.
Select objectives, acquisition channels, and acquisition time in “Scan Settings” within the IncuCyte system.
Select wells to be imaged and positions per well in “Scan Pattern”.
Choose scan interval/frequency and end point of the imaging experiment in “Scan Schedule”.
Secure plates firmly on the plate holder to image the same position in each well at every timepoint.
Set up parameters for imaging according to system prompts.
Select a 20X objective in "Scan Settings".
Choose two acquisition channels: phase contrast and RFP.
Set default acquisition time (400 ms) for both channels.
Use phenol-free media if phenol red causes autofluorescence on the green channel.
Select wells to be imaged in "Scan Pattern".
Image 16 positions per well for the selected iBidi μ-slide wells.
Estimate the scan duration based on the chosen pattern and acquisition time.
Select the scan interval/frequency in “Scan Schedule”.
Set up the end point of the imaging experiment.
Image cells every 30 minutes for up to 28 days.
Change media every 2/3 days as you would do for neurons cultured in an incubator.
Only change media when the IncuCyte is not imaging or operating.
Calculate the available time to change media based on scanning duration and frequency.
Check the status of the cells and the IncuCyte regularly during long-term imaging.
Ensure neurons are healthy and that imaging settings remain optimal.
Use the “View” function in the IncuCyte software to access scans completed mid-experiment.
Re-seed neurons into a new coated slide if they form 3D clusters after two weeks of differentiation.
Maintain a duplicate neuron plate in the cell culture incubator as a quality control and backup.
Export image series from the IncuCyte upon completion of imaging.
Analyze the exported image series using appropriate image analysis software.
